value.answer: Tuesday in Toronto is warm with some stormy weather. Expect a mix of sun and cloud, a high of 25 (humidex 32), and a 40% chance of showers with a risk of thunderstorms from late afternoon into the evening. Wind is southwest at 20 km/h, gusting to 40. It drops to a low of 15 overnight. No weather alerts are in effect. Wednesday turns much cooler, with a high of 16.
